segments.name: Software Defined Vehicles ("SDV")
segments.description: Develops and sells software systems for software-defined vehicles, including in-vehicle infotainment software, through Japanese subsidiaries.
segments.evidence: Software Defined Vehicles ("SDV"): relates to the development and sale of software systems designed for SDV, including IVI system software and other mobility-enhancing software products, conducted by Japanese subsidiaries.

segments.name: Location-Based Services ("LBS")
segments.evidence: Location-Based Services ("LBS"): relates to the development and licensing of in-vehicle navigation software systems, and other geographic data-based services for Business-to-Business ("B2B") customers, mainly serving end users.

segments.name: Other
segments.evidence: Other: primarily comprises software development services conducted by overseas subsidiaries designed for SDV, and Business-to-Consumer ("B2C") mobile app services unrelated to in-vehicle navigation.

changes.text: In 2024, upon Reorganization, the Company renamed HI Corporation to MAC and Databroad Co., Ltd. to MNC.
changes.evidence: On March 1, 2024, upon Reorganization, the Company renamed HI to MAC.

changes.text: In 2024, the Company acquired O-WELL GERMANY GmbH to provide mobility-related software and services to the EU and other international markets.
changes.evidence: On March 28, 2024, the Company acquired 100% of the equity interests in O-WELL GERMANY GmbH from O-WELL corporation in order to provide mobility-related software and services to the EU and other international markets.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company acquired the NaviCon smartphone-to-car navigation connectivity business and a taxi dispatch system business from Denso entities.
changes.evidence: On March 31, 2025, the Company acquired the NaviCon business from Denso Co., Ltd. pursuant to an acquisition agreement dated April 26, 2024.
